# LongBench v1 files

These prompt templates, output limits, and metric functions come from
[THUDM/LongBench](https://github.com/THUDM/LongBench), at the commit recorded
in `REVISION`. The metric file has trailing whitespace removed; its behavior
is unchanged. The upstream MIT license is included in `LongBench/LICENSE`.

The five JSONL task files are in `../../datasets/longbench-v1/`. Their source
archive and checksum are recorded in that directory's `manifest.json`.
